products.title: Three on the Green Golf Streetwear Sweatshirt
products.body_html:
The Three on the Green golf streetwear sweatshirt is the clean, everyday staple of the range: a heavyweight 400gsm cotton crewneck carrying just the TPG flag mark on the left chest.

No big graphic, no logo-soup, just an understated piece you'll reach for on repeat. The name plants the TPG flag on the green and nods to the three-putt that gave the brand its name.

At 400gsm of 100% cotton in a clean regular fit, it sits where golf meets streetwear: warm enough for autumn and winter rounds, smart enough for the clubhouse, and a crewneck that sidesteps the no-hood rules some clubs still have. No stiff country-club uniform, just a quality piece built to layer.

Three Putt makes golf apparel for the everyday golfer, whether you play a weekly medal, a monthly round with mates, or just stripe balls at the range. Available in five colourways: Cream, Off-White, Black, Grey Marl and Navy.
